hotel.name: The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort

verified_facts.text: The resort overlooks a beach, the Arabian Gulf and the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking a pristine beach, the cerulean Arabian Gulf and the celebrated Saadiyat Beach Golf Club

verified_facts.text: The resort is a few minutes from the Louvre Abu Dhabi.
verified_facts.excerpt: just minutes away from the iconic Louvre Abu Dhabi

verified_facts.text: The Saadiyat Beach Golf Club was the Arabian Gulf's first beachfront golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Arabian Gulf's first beachfront course, the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club

verified_facts.text: The Saadiyat Beach Golf Club course was designed by Gary Player.
verified_facts.excerpt: unique course design by world-famous golfer Gary Player

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has a private balcony and St. Regis Butler service available day or night.
verified_facts.excerpt: which each boast a private balcony and signature St. Regis Butler service-available any time, day or night

verified_facts.text: The resort pairs Mediterranean-inspired architecture with contemporary interiors and natural materials.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mediterranean-inspired architecture unites with contemporary interiors and tactile natural materials

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Calcutta marble floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: smooth Calcutta marble floors and natural materials

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite is a duplex across the hotel's top two levels.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxurious Royal Suite is a duplex spanning across the upper two levels of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Sontaya serves Southeast Asian food and sits among a series of interconnected pools overlooking the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floating amongst a series of interconnected pools, overlooking the resort's scenic beach, Sontaya Asian restaurant in Abu Dhabi offers a culinary mosaic of Southeast Asian fare

verified_facts.text: The Manhattan Lounge serves the Arabian Snapper, the hotel's Bloody Mary made with zaatar.
verified_facts.excerpt: here, it’s the Arabian Snapper, crafted with zaatar, a spice native to the region. Discover this storied ritual at The Manhattan Lounge.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea at Cafe Ginori Saadiyat Island is served on Ginori 1735 porcelain.
verified_facts.excerpt: afternoon tea at Café Ginori Saadiyat Island, served in elegant Ginori 1735 porcelain

verified_facts.text: Olea is a Mediterranean-inspired all-day restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating and live cooking stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcoming guests to relaxed indoor and outdoor all-day dining, the Mediterranean-inspired Oléa features live cooking stations

verified_facts.text: Buddha-Bar Beach Abu Dhabi is an Asian-fusion restaurant and bar set against the resort's beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Buddha-Bar Beach in Abu Dhabi offers a vibrant dining and bar experience against the resort's beach backdrop

verified_facts.text: Champagne sabering takes place nightly, a St. Regis tradition.
verified_facts.excerpt: as well as nightly Champagne sabering—another St Regis tradition

verified_facts.text: Hawksbill turtles find refuge in the beach dunes and dolphins play in the surf along the shore.
verified_facts.excerpt: so sublime that Hawksbill Turtles find refuge in the dunes and dolphins play in the surf along the shore

verified_facts.text: Gazelles graze on the golf course next to the resort.

verified_facts.text: There is an outdoor children's pool with waterfalls and toys.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids will enjoy splashing around in our outdoor children's pool, complete with waterfalls and toys.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two outdoor, lighted hard tennis courts with complimentary rackets and balls.

verified_facts.text: Two complimentary indoor squash courts are available, with a playing partner if needed.
verified_facts.excerpt: two complimentary indoor squash courts. Available to in-house guests of all ages, the squash courts include balls, rackets, and towels—plus a playing partner, if needed.

verified_facts.text: The head concierge is a member of Les Clefs d'Or.
